Hi Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the options. We tried to open the Meet link but Novum’s web policy blocks Google Meet frames/iframes and our corporate Outlook (when people forward invites) strips out the join button so external Meet URLs often disappear for some attendees. IT is cc’ed — they’ll confirm, but in the past the simplest path has been:

1) Send a Zoom meeting link (we can open Zoom just fine)
2) Attach an .ics to the invite so people who rely on Outlook forwarded copies still get a working join line in their calendar entry

Can you send a Zoom-based invite + .ics and we’ll confirm the time. Prefer Wed 5/19 14:00 PT if that still works.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Clinical Data Platforms
Novum Health
